conversations:
Mercedes Woolley <mercedes.woolley@usu.edu>:
Hi Hanna, I received this email letting me know that my study (#4020) is being deleted. We purchased a yearlong license for this study in August and are currently collected data and are actively enrolling participants, so I am a little concerned that this project is going to be deleted. Please let me know if there is anything I need to do to prevent this from happening. Thanks, Mercedes
----

Avicenna Research <no-reply@avicennaresearch.com>:
Wednesday, October 2, 2024 at 1:36 AM To: Mercedes Woolley <mercedes.woolley@usu.edu> Subject: Data for your study will be deleted in 3 days Data for your study will be deleted in 3 days Hi Mercedes, We wanted to let you know that your trial study on Avicenna Research, #4020, titled "Process-Based Therapy for Trichotillomania Study" will reset in 3 days . This means all data collected so far as part of this study will be removed. Why my study's data is being erased? We regularly clean up trial studies on Avicenna. Of course, you can collect new data for this study, and continue trying out Avicenna. If you would like to keep the study data, please consider purchasing a license. You can do so by contacting sales@avicennaresearch.com . What exactly is being erased Every data that is received from any of the participants, including sensor data, survey responses, cognitive tasks, and participant history. Currently, enrolled participants remain enrolled and can continue uploading data to your study. How should I stop this? If you need to keep these data in your Avicenna account, please contact sales@avicennaresearch.com and we will be able to help you acquire a license. Thanks for using our site! Avicenna For better patient experience. About Blog Learn Contact Us All Rights Reserved © 2024 Avicenna Research Inc.------

Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Mercedes, This is Sara from Avicenna Research, and I hope you are doing well. Thanks a lot for letting us know. I set the study as licensed and linked it to the license you had purchased. If you check the dashboard now, you should see the study marked as licensed. This process still is manual on our platform (researcher should request a study to be set as licensed), but we are in the middle of rewriting and improving this completely. If you have any questions or need anything else from us, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Best, Sara --Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Wednesday, October 2, 2024 at 6:14:46 PM,
